note: Mischievously Drinkable (Elysian Brewing, Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026): requires one of four specific Elysian Dust Series beers (Space Dust IPA, Juice Dust Juicy IPA, Phaze Dust Hazy IPA, Easy Dust Non-Alc IPA) - a brewery/specific-beer match, not a style or country match, so special_badges.json's reader (kind: style/country only) can't compute this.

Punchtöberfest (Oct 1-31, 2026, sponsored by Punch Cigars): criteria is 'check in any beer ... in the USA only', which reads as a check-in VENUE location restriction, not a brewery-country match - badge_stats.compute_special_badges' 'country' kind matches a beer's own country field (brewery origin), so this isn't the same thing and can't be safely encoded as kind: country without risking false positives for e.g. a US drinker checking in a German import.

NC Beer Month Passport (Oct 1-31, 2026): four separate badges (Welcome + Level 1/2/3) requiring check-ins at 1/5/10/15 distinct North Carolina breweries respectively - a venue-location (state) + distinct-brewery-count match, not a style or country match, so special_badges.json's reader (kind: style/country only) can't compute this.

Barrel-Aged Beer Day 2026 (Oct 2-11, 2026): criteria is 'check-in (1) beer from any of the styles commonly involved in barrel-aging' - the post lists a long, loosely-worded set of styles (Altbier, Barleywine, Belgian Dubbel/Tripel/Quad, Bock variations, Brown Ale, Brett Beer, Farmhouse Ale, Lambic varieties, Porter, multiple Stout types, Sour beers, Wild Ale, and more) explicitly qualified as styles that 'can, but may not always, be barrel-aged' - not a precise, exact set of Untappd taxonomy leaf names, so too ambiguous to encode confidently as kind: style without risking wrong matches.
